title: Cozy Nest • Near Downtown • Affordable • Pets OK
description:
Relax and unwind at the “Cozy Nest,” a charming 1920s duplex. This clean, cozy 1BR/1BA features a queen bed, fully equipped kitchen, WiFi, and Smart TV. Enjoy easy street parking and quick access to downtown (1.8 miles)—honky-tonks, Marathon Village, Titans Stadium, Bridgestone Arena, Vanderbilt, and hospitals. A comfortable, convenient home base for your Nashville stay.

The space
This is a 1920's home that's now a duplex - a classic Nashville structure of its time - uniquely private in the heart of the city.  Completely updated kitchen. It is small - 525 sq.ft. There is "on street" parking in front of the house.  The "Nest" is so close to EVERYTHING!  It is in an urban neighborhood with a mix of new construction, modest housing and industrial. Trains nearby. Complimentary ear plugs provided;-) Folks don't really seem to mind the train. Pet rules to follow and loud, disruptive or aggressive pet will terminate your stay.
Since we do not reside on the property, Security Cameras are at the front door and on a building in the back yard. These cameras are always "on and recording" which allows for viewing and monitoring of ONLY the public space.  The security cameras are clearly identified and are disclosed ahead of a reservation confirmation.

Guest access
Self Check-in with an electronic lock.  Code will be given the day of your arrival.

Other things to note
- "Quiet enjoyment" time between 10pm and 7am
-  Occupancy limited to 2. 
- No additional overnight guests without host approval.
- No 3rd Party Booking. The Guest booking the reservation MUST BE the Guest staying.
- Loud, disruptive or aggressive pets will terminate your stay.
- Trains nearby. Complimentary ear plugs provided. Folks don't really seem to mind.
- Guests must be 25 or older.

I'm a native Nashvillian... a rarity theses days! I'm a metal sculpture artist and a home renovator! My partner, Lisa and I own several rental properties and airbnb's.  We take great joy in sharing our special places. We enjoy travel, music, food and spending time with family and friends. My daughter, Cara is proprietor of one of the best restaurants in Nashville... Lockeland Table in East Nashville. Be sure to say "BeBe" sent ya :-)

We love sharing our little places. Since we can't be there all the time - it's better knowing that others can be there enjoying them. These are unique places and nothing fancy but totally relaxing and with all the comforts. We are a text/call away if you need anything and our neighbors are very helpful too.
